name: tgsync
description: Obsidian plugin: sync your vault, end-to-end encrypted, through a private Telegram group

scripts.test: rm -rf .test-out && esbuild host/test/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.test-out/host --packages=external --loader:.wasm=binary --target=node20 --log-level=warning && esbuild test/plugin.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.test-out/plugin.test.cjs --alias:obsidian=./test/obsidian-stub.ts --target=node20 --loader:.wasm=binary --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --log-level=warning && node --test .test-out/host/*.test.js .test-out/plugin.test.cjs
